reasons: B correctly grounds the property deduction in ст. 220 НК РФ, while A repeatedly cites ст. 219 (social deductions) as the legal basis, which is a core error for the user's question. A also contains calculation and rule errors (300 000 not 390 000 at 15% on 2 млн; since 2014 each co-owner has their own 2 млн limit) and starts with a stray timestamp line. B has smaller slips (employer route cited as ст. 221 п. 3, an odd hotline number, dated framing of the progressive-rate reform) but is more accurate on the main points.

A: Cites ст. 219 НК РФ as the basis for the property deduction; the property deduction is in ст. 220 (219 covers social deductions).
Max refund on 2 млн at 15% given as 390 000 ₽; it would be 300 000 ₽.
States the 2 млн limit is divided among co-owners (п. 3 ст. 219); since 2014 each owner has their own limit.
Attributes transfer of the unused balance to ФЗ № 302-ФЗ of 21.11.2013; the change came from 212-ФЗ of 23.07.2013.
Employer route cited as ст. 219.1, which is not the correct provision.
B: Employer route cited as ст. 221 п. 3; the correct basis is п. 8 ст. 220 НК РФ.
Gives the ФНС hotline as 802-122-002; the actual number is 8-800-222-22-22.
Describes the progressive НДФЛ scale as only under discussion, though 15% applies from 2021 and a multi-tier scale from 2025; also implies the deduction requires the 13% rate.
